rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Opening the 69th joint session of 22 April 1985, the President of Congress, Senator José Fragelli, recalled that the Vice-President, José Sarney, had taken the constitutional oath before the National Congress on 15 March 1985.

locator.item: 'ao Vice-Presidente, sua Excelência o Senhor Doutor José Sarney, que já prestou, perante o Congresso Nacional, a 15 de março do corrente ano, o compromisso constitucional'

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Republic in exercise of the office of President
rows.text: The same statement says that the Vice-President had since then been in the exercise of the Presidency by reason of the impediment of the holder (the President-elect).

locator.item: 'encontra-se, desde então, no exercício da Presidência em virtude do impedimento do titular'

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: He stated that, President-elect Tancredo de Almeida Neves having died, the office of President of the Republic being vacant, it fell to the Vice-President, José Sarney, as successor of the President-elect, to exercise the office of President of the Republic under Article 77, caput, of the Constitution.

locator.item: summary 'vacância do cargo de Presidente da República; e assunção do Doutor José Sarney ao cargo de Presidente da República'; 'Vago o cargo de Presidente da República, ao Vice-Presidente ... cabe exercer, como sucessor ...'

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Mensagem nº 232, dated Brasília 21 April 1985, signed José Sarney and read at the session, informs the President of the Senate of the death that day of President-elect Tancredo de Almeida Neves and states that Sarney continues to exercise, now as successor, the office of President of the Republic under Article 77 of the Constitution.

locator.item: MENSAGEM Nº 232: 'continuo a exercer, agora na qualidade de sucessor, o cargo de Presidente da República'
